name: io.github.Nullclear-Protocol/nullclear
title: NullClear Pre-Execution Firewall & Arbiter
description: 7-chain EVM/Solana 1-call Pre-Sign Firewall, Guarded RPC, Proxy/ABI Inspector & x402 Escrow

tools.name: nullclear_scan_token
tools.description: Perform a free multi-chain (Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BSC, Solana) token security, proxy resolution, Token-2022 extension/mint/freeze authority audit, honeypot, and buy/sell tax audit (10 free calls/day/IP, zero API key; then $0.005 USDC). Returns score, verdict, recommendedAgentAction, proxy implementation, tax percentages, LP USD, and provenance block number (<400 tokens). Do NOT use for low-level 4-byte selector disassembly on non-token contracts (use nullclear_inspect_contract).

address.description: Token or contract address (0x-prefixed 42-char EVM hex, or Base58 mint address for Solana)

chain.description: Target blockchain network; auto-detects if address exists on an alternate supported chain

tools.name: nullclear_inspect_contract
tools.description: Disassemble deployed EVM bytecode across Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, or BSC to resolve EIP-1967/1822/1167/Beacon/Diamond/Safe proxies, query Sourcify v2 verified ABIs, batch-resolve PUSH4 selectors via OpenChain, and analyze control-flow opcode risks (tx.origin, mutable DELEGATECALL, unguarded SELFDESTRUCT) without an Etherscan key (10 free calls/day/IP).

tools.name: nullclear_decode_calldata
tools.description: Decode EVM calldata (recursively unwrapping Multicall3, Uniswap Universal Router, Safe execTransaction), EIP-712 typed-data signatures (Permit, Permit2, Seaport), Solana wire transactions (Base64/Base58), custom Solidity revert bytes, or mined tx hashes with verified-router spender trust classification (10 free calls/day/IP).

input.description: 0x-prefixed hex calldata/revert bytes, 66-char tx hash, or Base64/Base58 Solana transaction

typedData.description: Optional EIP-712 typedData JSON (Permit, Permit2, Seaport, SafeTx)

tools.name: nullclear_simulate_transaction
tools.description: Execute stateful pre-flight simulation across EVM (eth_simulateV1 with stateOverrides, multi-tx bundles, and Transfer/Approval net asset diffs; fallback eth_call + eth_estimateGas) and Solana (simulateTransaction + wire instruction audit) BEFORE signing (10 free calls/day/IP).

to.description: Destination 0x smart contract address (required for single EVM call)

value.description: Native wei amount as hex ('0x0') or decimal string

transactions.description: Optional ordered multi-tx EVM bundle [{ to, data, value }]

transaction.description: Base64/Base58 serialized Solana transaction when chain='solana'

tools.name: nullclear_read_markdown
tools.description: Fetch and convert any public web documentation URL or HTML article into clean, stripped Markdown (<400 tokens) with a SHA-256 content hash. Use this when reading documentation, blog posts, or web pages while minimizing context-window noise (10 free calls/day/IP). Returns markdown body and provenance hash. Do NOT use for JSON REST APIs or schema-enforced x402 data endpoints needing LLM-refusal/5xx protection (use nullclear_fetch_guarded or nullclear_execute_escrow).

url.description: Public HTTPS webpage or documentation URL to extract into clean Markdown

tools.name: nullclear_preflight_guard
tools.description: All-in-one 1-call Pre-Sign Firewall across Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BSC, and Solana (10 free calls/day/IP). In one pass, recursively unwraps Multicall3/Uniswap Universal Router/Safe calldata or EIP-712 Permits or Solana wire txs, runs stateful eth_simulateV1 / Solana simulateTransaction with asset balance diffs, and automatically scans all touched token contracts for honeypots, taxes, and Token-2022 permanent delegates. Returns one deterministic recommendedAgentAction (EXECUTE_SAFE / CAUTION_HIGH_RISK / ABORT_*).

to.description: Target contract 0x address or Solana mint

transactions.description: Optional ordered multi-tx bundle [{ to, data, value }]

typedData.description: Optional EIP-712 typedData object (Permit, Permit2, Seaport, SafeTx) to audit before signing

transaction.description: Optional Base64/Base58 serialized Solana transaction to decode and simulate

tools.name: nullclear_discover_apis
tools.description: Search NullClear's audited x402 and ERC-8004 endpoint directory by keyword, category, minimum uptime, and maximum latency. Use this before paying external x402 sellers to find reliable APIs and retrieve their NullClear Zero-Loss Proxy URL (`https://api.nullclear.dev/https://...`). Returns matched endpoints with priceAtomic, uptimeScore, latencyMs, and proxy URL. Do NOT use to execute a call (pass the returned URL to nullclear_execute_escrow).

query.description: Keyword filter matching endpoint URL or description (e.g. 'oracle', 'security', 'token', 'wallet')

minUptime.description: Minimum rolling uptime percentage threshold from 0 to 100 (default 95)

maxLatencyMs.description: Maximum acceptable edge round-trip latency in milliseconds (default 2000)

verifiedOnly.description: When true, filter exclusively to canary-verified HTTP 402 endpoints (default true)

tools.name: nullclear_audit_paid_token
tools.description: Run NullClear's x402 Bazaar paid oracle for Base Mainnet (8453) ERC-20 tokens returning a cryptographically signed clearing receipt (10 free trial calls/day, then $0.005 USDC). Use this ONLY when you specifically require a Base Bazaar EIP-712/keccak256 settlement receipt alongside token LP and bytecode verification. For free (10/day) multi-chain Base/ETH/Solana token & proxy scanning, use nullclear_scan_token instead.

tokenAddress.description: 0x-prefixed Base Mainnet (chain 8453) ERC-20 token contract address

tools.name: nullclear_score_wallet
tools.description: Profile a raw 0x EVM wallet address on Base Mainnet (8453) for OFAC sanctions exposure, on-chain counterparty wash-trade concentration, ETH/USDC balances, transaction count, and ERC-8004 ownership (10 free trials/day, then $0.005 USDC). Returns riskScore (0-100), riskLevel, and ERC-8004 registration status. Do NOT pass a numeric ERC-8004 agent ID here — use nullclear_check_reputation for numeric agentId trust audits.

walletAddress.description: 0x-prefixed 42-char EVM wallet address on Base Mainnet to screen

chainId.description: EVM chain ID (default 8453 for Base Mainnet)

tools.name: nullclear_fetch_spot_price
tools.description: Query cross-exchange spot prices (Coinbase + Binance) for major crypto pairs with deterministic positive-price invariant verification and signed attestation (10 free trials/day, then $0.01 USDC). Returns priceUsd, source, invariantCheck ('PASSED'), and execution receipt. Use this whenever a verified non-hallucinated crypto spot price feed is needed.

pair.description: Asset ticker or pair such as 'ETH/USDC', 'BTC/USDC', 'SOL/USDC', or 'ETH-USD'

tools.name: nullclear_fetch_guarded
tools.description: Execute a zero-schema Auto-Guarded HTTP GET/POST request through NullClear's firewall against HTTP 5xx crashes, empty JSON bodies, Cloudflare/soft-paywall traps, and LLM refusal strings (10 free trials/day, then $0.005 USDC via Bazaar). Returns verified payload and executionReceipt, or voids settlement on failure. Do NOT use for plain HTML docs-to-Markdown conversion (use nullclear_read_markdown) or when custom JSON Schema/invariants/failover are needed (use nullclear_execute_escrow).

url.description: Public HTTPS API or data endpoint URL to fetch with automatic crash, paywall, and refusal guards

body.description: Optional serialized JSON request body string for POST requests

tools.name: nullclear_execute_escrow
tools.description: Execute a paid x402 API request protected by NullClear deferred non-custodial EIP-3009 escrow, custom JSON Schema/value invariants, multi-seller failover routing, and outbound spend caps (10 free trials/day, then requires configured wallet key). Settles upstream payment ONLY when all schema, numeric, staleness, and refusal checks pass; otherwise voids authorization ($0 lost). Use this instead of nullclear_fetch_guarded whenever calling third-party x402 paid APIs with strict output contracts or fallback sellers.

targetUrl.description: Primary upstream HTTPS endpoint demanding HTTP 402 payment

sellerAgentId.description: ERC-8004 seller agent ID for pre-flight trust and Sybil gating

requiredFields.description: Dot-notation field paths that must exist in upstream JSON

jsonSchema.description: JSON Schema Draft-07 object that upstream JSON must strictly satisfy

invariants.description: Field-level semantic invariants (numeric bounds, regex, forbidden substrings, timestamp freshness)

rejectRefusals.description: Void settlement if response contains canonical LLM refusal strings (default true)

fallbacks.description: Up to 3 ordered backup seller objects ({ targetUrl, sellerAgentId, paymentSignatureHeader }) for automatic failover

spendPolicy.description: Outbound spend firewall caps ({ maxPerCallAtomic, maxDailyWalletAtomic })

tools.name: nullclear_check_reputation
tools.description: Retrieve an ERC-8004 registered agent's composite trust score (0-100), letter grade (A-F), historical clearing count, and Sybil wash-trading penalty flags by numeric agentId. Returns arbiter-signed reputation metrics and sybilFlags. Use this ONLY for registered ERC-8004 agent IDs (e.g. '124595'); for raw 0x wallet address OFAC/balance profiling use nullclear_score_wallet, and for legal corporate liability limits use nullclear_verify_mandate.

agentId.description: Registered numeric ERC-8004 agent token ID (e.g. '124595')

chainId.description: Target EVM chain ID (8453 for Base Mainnet, 84532 for Base Sepolia)

tools.name: nullclear_verify_mandate
tools.description: Verify an autonomous agent's Know Your Agent (KYA) EIP-712 corporate liability mandate, jurisdiction, expiration status, and whether a proposed USD transaction amount complies with corporate per-transaction caps. Returns approved boolean, corporateEntity, liabilityCoverageUsd, maxTxLimitUsd, and expiration/limit flags. Use this specifically for corporate authorization checks — not for on-chain Sybil scoring (use nullclear_check_reputation).

agentId.description: Registered numeric ERC-8004 agent token ID bound to a KYA mandate

chainId.description: EVM chain ID (default 8453 for Base Mainnet)

transactionAmountUsd.description: Proposed transaction size in USD to validate against the mandate limit
